mdcalc_rules: Points = age in years; female -10; nursing home +10; neoplastic disease +30; liver disease +20; CHF +10; cerebrovascular disease +10; renal disease +10; altered mental status +20; RR >=30 +20; SBP <90 +20; temp <35C or >39.9C (Step-1 text says >=40C) +15; pulse >=125 +10; pH <7.35 +30; BUN >=30 mg/dL (>=11 mmol/L) +20; Na <130 mmol/L +20; glucose >=250 mg/dL (>=14 mmol/L) +10; Hct <30% +10; PaO2 <60 mmHg (<8 kPa) +10; pleural effusion +10. Classes: <=70, 71-90, 91-130, >130. MDCalc page lists PaO2 only (no SaO2 <90% option, which Fine 1997 includes) and gives no definitions for comorbidities.
